defmodule ZombiesGameWeb.PlayerController do
  use ZombiesGameWeb, :controller

  # GET /api/player/:player_id  (auth plug already verified the JWT)
  def show(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Profile.get_player(id) do
      {:ok, player} -> json(conn, %{id: player.id, coins: player.coins, lives: player.lives})
      {:error, :not_found} -> conn |> put_status(:not_found) |> json(%{error: "not_found"})
    end
  end
end
